title: Implementation DTO (S8 output, S10 input, S11 assertion source)

id.description: e.g. dto-0012; one commit per DTO in S10

anchor.description: Symbol or code-shape anchor for insertion; line numbers are advisory only

preconditions.description: Code-shape assumptions that must hold; violation aborts this DTO, not the run

expected_events.description: What S11 must observe when this code path is exercised

event_type.description: Was a closed nine-value, GenAI-shaped enum; opened to any well-formed identifier (docs/decisions/011) so a second domain pack's own event_types validate without a schema edit. Real membership is the loaded pack's event_types.

consistency_assertions.description: Predicate expressions over this event's own attributes that must hold together, not just be present, e.g. "access_result == 'restricted' implies source_ids == [] and needs_review == true". Field presence alone does not satisfy an assertion here.

parented_under.description: Expected parent span relationship, if asserted

risk.description: High-risk DTOs (e.g. context propagation changes) get extra review flagging in S9

retest_triggers.description: Files or config keys whose change invalidates this DTO's recorded S11 evidence, e.g. 'prompts/policy_v*.md', 'config/retrieval.yaml#index_id'. Consumed by `oah check-drift` to flag stale validation without a full pipeline re-run.
